# Jackson Shi's Blog

> A tech blog featuring Rust programming tutorials, LeetCode algorithm solutions, and web development insights built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.

Jackson Shi maintains a focused technical blog covering computer science fundamentals and modern programming languages. The site emphasizes practical problem-solving through LeetCode challenges and deep dives into Rust's memory management systems.

## Key Topics

- Rust
- LeetCode
- Binary Search
- Smart Pointers
- Rc and Weak References
- Arc
- RefCell
- Algorithm Solutions
- Coding Interviews
- Next.js
- Tailwind CSS
- Web Development
- Reference Counter
- Rotated Sorted Arrays
- Newton's Method

## Core Pages

- [Jackson Shi's Blog](https://jacksonshi.vercel.app): Homepage featuring tech blog on Rust, algorithms, and web development
- [Blog Index](https://jacksonshi.vercel.app/blog): Blog index page with LeetCode solutions and Rust programming tutorials

## Rust Programming

- [Rc and Weak in Rust](https://jacksonshi.vercel.app/blog/rust/rc-weak-rust): Tutorial on Rust smart pointers: Rc, Arc, and Weak references for memory management

## LeetCode Algorithm Solutions

- [Leetcode 153. Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array](https://jacksonshi.vercel.app/blog/leetcode/leetcode-find-minimum-in-rotated-sorted-array): Binary search solution on rotated sorted array implemented in Rust
- [Leetcode 69. Sqrt(x)](https://jacksonshi.vercel.app/blog/leetcode/leetcode-sqrt(x)): Binary search and Newton's method approaches for computing square roots
- [Leetcode 162. Find Peak Element](https://jacksonshi.vercel.app/blog/leetcode/leetcode-find-peak-in-list): Binary search algorithm for efficiently finding peak elements in arrays

## Web Development & Tools

- [Introducing Tailwind Nextjs Starter Blog](https://jacksonshi.vercel.app/blog/introducing-tailwind-nextjs-starter-blog): Article about the Next.js and Tailwind CSS blog template used to build this site
